newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs mostly lower, pork bellies tumble.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs mostly lower, pork bellies tumble.

text.p: CME hog futures generally posted losses at the start with pork bellies down sharply as sell stops added to the setback, traders said.
Expectations that cash hog prices would ease this week as cooler weather sets in, weighed on hog futures while pork bellies fell as carryover selling hit sell stops, they said.
At 0914 CDT, hog futures were off 0.225 cent per lb to up 0.250 cent with August off most at 81.800 cents. Pork bellies were off 2.000 to 0.175 with August off 1.600 at 82.050 cents.
